title: Intrinsic finite constructibility in the fixed coefficient presentation
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and B a finite commutative ring in the site coefficient universe. For any isomorphism e from the constant B ring sheaf to the recorded function coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], let G be a fixed B-module-valued sheaf on the small pro-etale site. Realize G as a module over the recorded finite coefficient ring, restrict along finiteRingComparison and then e. If this module is intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], then G is constructible in the fixed-module finite-global-stratification sense. This assertion concerns a single sheaf and contains no derived object, bounds, or tower.

source.place: Tags 09AJ and 099Y; associated-module-sheaf encoding via Tag 00YV; finite coefficient presentation transport

proof.text: Forget the supplied relative finite module models to sheaves of sets. The module inverse-image comparison identifies these with inverse images of the constant finite underlying sets. Coefficient realization and scalar restriction retain the underlying sheaf, by the sheafification counit, even for an arbitrary presenting ring isomorphism. Thus on each stratum the fixed-ring module sheaf has finite constant underlying set models. To recover constant module models, intersect the finitely many image covering sieves making the additions, zero and scalar multiples of its constant sections constant. Their restricted values form a finite submodule of the sections on each covering member. The resulting map from its constant module presheaf is locally injective and locally surjective: compare its underlying map with the locally bijective constant-set sheafification unit. Sheafification makes it an isomorphism. Compose these covers and transport along the equivalence between a slice of the pro-etale site and the pro-etale site of the covering object. The original finite constructible stratification now witnesses fixed-ring constructibility.

theorem finiteCoefficient_intrinsic_constructible
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (e : adicLisseConstantRing X B ≅ AdicCoefficients.coefficientRing X B) :
    letI : TopologicalSpace B := ⊥
    letI : DiscreteTopology B := discreteTopology_bot _
    ∀ G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B),
      IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf X B
        ((pbcRestrict e.hom).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (AdicCoefficients.finiteRingComparison X B).hom).obj
              ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientRealization X B).obj G))) →
      ProEtale.IsConstructible B G
